system.description:
You must be in a Taijutsu Stance to cast this jutsu. You stand calm and still, emptying your mind and merging your Tin and Tang Chakras into an explosive fusion of your physical and spiritual abilities. You now control the entire radius within your arm’s length, creating a spherical shield around you.

For the duration, creatures who make a melee attack targeting you suffer a 1d4 penalty to their attack rolls.

In addition, damage you deal to them as a result of a melee attack forces them to make a Constitution saving throw, once per turn as you efficiently and brutally break down their defenses with every strike. On a failed save, the target is Exposed until the beginning of your next turn. An exposed creature cannot gain bonuses to their AC or DR for the duration.

roll.note: For the duration, creatures who make a melee attack targeting you suffer a 1d4 penalty to their attack rolls.
